annotations.text: Hello! Elections to the CEDAW Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women will Be held on June 2018.

annotations.text: Ms. Ana Peláez, a blind woman, is the Spanish government candidate.
annotations.signer_description: Mujer pelo corto, chaqueta de cuero

annotations.text: Ms. Ana Peláez has great career as an advocate for the rights of women and girls with disabilities in Spain, Europe and worldwide.
annotations.signer_description: Mujer pelo corto, chaqueta de cuero

annotations.text: Never before has a woman whit disability been a member of the CEDAW Committee and we know women and girls with disabilities are victims of aggravated forms of discrimination.

annotations.text: CNSE, National Confederation of the Deaf in Spain, supports the candidacy of Ana Peláez for the CEDAW Committee.
